_about: Whole documents. `valid` must load; each `invalid` entry must be refused by the Engine with an error mentioning `error`. Entries with "client": true must also be refused by both clients' own checks (contract compatibility and structure), since a client cannot assume every server validated what it sends.

valid.name: own-icons
valid._why: 1.2: a Satellite's own icons, which the Engine adds to the document it serves: a navigation item, a list item, a viewer action and a binding may name one, and a refused file keeps its fallback alone.

valid.name: media-blocks
valid._why: 1.2: an image and a media-list, both loaded from the Satellite's own routes.

valid.name: media-grid-tiles
valid._why: 1.2: folder tiles - an item's icon drawn when it has no image, and a tile action chosen per item: the first `open` entry whose `visible` holds (one tile opens the Satellite's own interface, the others a page).

valid.name: media-grid-quick
valid._why: 1.2: a quick action on each tile - the first entry whose `visible` holds is a small button in the tile's corner (a heart that adds, or the active heart that removes), beside the viewer.

valid.name: file-actions
valid._why: 1.2: download and share - the client fetches the Satellite's own route with its session, then saves the file or hands it to the system share sheet, named from the item; a download with open: true opens it with the platform instead.

valid.name: upload-action
valid._why: 1.2: upload - the person picks files, each sent as a raw POST body to the route with $value its {name, size}; a 409 asks, naming the file, then retries on the conflict route.

conflict.confirm: A file with this name is already here. Replace it?

valid.name: media-grid
valid._why: 1.2: a gallery of images and videos from the Satellite's own routes, grouped, with the shared viewer and selection; a preview document, so a client with the Satellite's own interface keeps it.

valid.name: search-and-map
valid._why: 1.2: a search field and a filter set page state, which the source route is templated with; results in a media-grid, and located items on a map that opens the shared viewer.

valid.name: paged-grid-and-viewport-map
valid._why: 1.2: a media-grid that loads its next page from the provider's cursor, and a map that loads what is on screen (items or the provider's own clusters).

valid.name: pick-action
valid._why: 1.2: the client's media picker chooses from whichever Satellite provides media.gallery, then the action's route gets the references as $value.

valid.name: own-action
valid._why: 1.2: a control opens the Satellite's own interface (its page.js, its native screens) at a section, for what stays native; a client without one hides it.

valid.name: offline-page
valid._why: 1.2: a page the client may keep to show while StarCore can't be reached - its data and a grid's loaded pages.

valid.name: secure-action
valid._why: 1.2: a viewer's and a selection's action moving the items into whichever Satellite provides media.vault, behind the client's own unlock prompt; the document names no route, prompt or PIN field.

valid.name: paged-lists
valid._why: 1.2: two long lists on one page, each arriving page by page from its own cursor (a folder's folders, then its files).

valid.name: offline-page-with-a-choice
valid._why: 1.2: an offline page whose source depends on a choice's state: a handful of fixed values, so the client keeps one collection per value (a search's free text is still never kept).

valid.name: offline-page-omitting-fields
valid._why: 1.2: the client keeps only what the page binds, and never a field named in omit, at any depth.

valid.name: play-action
valid._why: 1.2: a button asks the client to play what the audio.library provider finds; it needs the media.audio client capability and an audio.library provider.

valid.name: play-tracks
valid._why: 1.2: a page plays its own Satellite's tracks: a row plays the list from that row, a button shuffles it, another plays what a route answers, and a row adds one track to the queue. The Satellite must provide audio.library.

valid.name: track-rows
valid._why: 1.2: a long list of the Satellite's own tracks: rows page by page (more) kept by their key, in groups, a heart pair at each row's end (a toggle: each entry drawn while its visible holds, and the answer's item updates the row), a menu that plays, queues, opens and downloads, and the playing row marked (item.audio).

valid.name: shelves
valid._why: 1.2: a media-grid with layout row is a shelf, one row that scrolls sideways; its tiles may play from their quick button and carry a menu.

valid.name: newer-minor-with-unknown-block
valid._why: A Satellite written for 1.4 still loads on an Engine and clients that know 1.0: blocks they don't know are skipped.

valid.name: requires-audio
valid._why: A document may require the media.audio client capability and an audio.library provider; a client that can't meet them says why instead of opening it.

valid.name: breadcrumb
valid._why: 1.2: the way down to the current place on one row - each entry but the last navigates, the last is where the person is.

valid.name: actions-row
valid._why: 1.2 (change 11): a page's actions on one line; a dropdown opens a panel under its button holding a form. The page carries its own way out, so it asks for no Back (change 12).

valid.name: protected-document
valid._why: 1.2: a store the client unlocks first, through the media.vault its own Satellite provides: status before any page, the setup page when it is not set up, its own prompt when locked, keep while shown, lock when left.

valid.name: protected-forgot-page
valid._why: 1.2: the client's unlock prompt offers "Forgot your PIN?" and opens this page instead, served without an unlock like the setup page; its action resets the PIN with the recovery key, and the client asks status again after it.

valid.name: protected-secrets-and-reveal
valid._why: 1.2: in a protected document, a route action asks for a new PIN (twice) and the current one in the client's own prompt, and another shows the recovery key in the answer once, in the client's own dialog; no form holds either.

valid.name: form-rows
valid._why: 1.2: a form field of repeatable rows - the person adds and removes rows of the same inputs, and the form sends them as a list of objects under the field's key.

valid.name: section-action
valid._why: 1.2: opens the shared document of a Satellite whose manifest says it is a section of this one, by name or from the data.

valid.name: sync-action
valid._why: 1.2: opens the client's own sync screen for the document's own media.sync provider; the document names no route, text or setting of the sync.

valid.name: choose-and-reorder
valid._why: 1.2: choose - the person picks one of the Satellite's own rows (or creates one by name), then the route runs with it as $value, a 409 asking before the conflict route; reorder - a whole, keyed list whose rows the person moves, one request per move with $value {from, to}.

blocks.label: Add the first song to another playlist

valid.name: audio-reloads-and-follows
valid._why: 1.2: audio - what the audio host adds to its player while it plays from this Satellite, with the playing track as $.: a menu after the host's own entries, links on the title and artist, a way to the library; reloads - a route action after which the client reloads what it keeps of the Satellite's audio.session (the host's likes and preferences); follows - a page whose sources load again when the client changes that state itself.

valid.name: offline-action
valid._why: 1.2, change 10: a page keeps its own Satellite's tracks on the device - a button the page's list, another what a route answers, a row's menu that one track - and a link opens the client's own Downloads screen. The labels and state are the client's; the Satellite must provide audio.library.

invalid.name: protected-an-unknown-capability
invalid._why: only what protected_capabilities lists: a client that doesn't know how to unlock a store must not show it

invalid.name: protected-offline-page
invalid._why: a protected document keeps nothing

invalid.name: protected-widgets
invalid._why: nothing of a protected document is shown outside it

invalid.name: secrets-outside-a-protected-document
invalid._why: no other document can raise a PIN prompt: the client's prompt is only for the store it unlocks

invalid.name: reveal-outside-a-protected-document
invalid._why: only a protected document's answer is shown in the client's own dialog

invalid.name: secrets-an-unknown-kind
invalid._why: kinds are a closed list: a client never prompts for something it doesn't know

invalid.name: secrets-a-new-recovery-key
invalid._why: only a PIN is chosen anew; a recovery key is made by the server and revealed

invalid.name: secrets-with-get
invalid._why: a secret goes in a POST's body, never in a URL

invalid.name: secrets-in-a-selection
invalid._why: asked once for one request, not once per item

invalid.name: secrets-a-form-field
invalid._why: a secret is never typed in a form

invalid.name: rows-inside-a-row
invalid._why: one level of rows: a row's inputs are plain inputs

invalid.name: rows-a-row-input-with-a-value
invalid._why: a new row starts empty; the rows field's value holds the rows

invalid.name: section-with-a-route
invalid._why: a section action opens a document, it calls nothing

invalid.name: media-grid-quick-empty
invalid.error: must be a list of {label, action}

invalid.name: list-more-on-an-offline-page
invalid.error: can't keep a list that loads further pages

invalid.name: offline-omit-an-item-key
invalid._why: a kept grid needs the field its items are keyed by and their thumbnails are reached with

invalid.name: secure-an-operation-it-may-not-ask-for
invalid._why: only the operations secure_operations lists: never one that reads or takes items out of the vault

invalid.name: secure-outside-media-actions
invalid._why: only on the items a media viewer shows or a selection holds

invalid.name: secure-with-a-route
invalid._why: it reaches no route of the document's own

invalid.name: secure-with-a-form-for-the-pin
invalid._why: the PIN is only ever typed in the client's own prompt

invalid.name: menu-empty
invalid.error: must be a list of {label, action}

invalid.name: update-outside-a-row
invalid.error: only in a media-list's or media-grid's quick and menu

invalid.name: sync-with-a-setting
invalid._why: the sync screen is the client's: the document sets nothing of it

invalid.name: sync-with-a-route
invalid._why: a sync action opens a screen, it calls nothing

invalid.name: own-icon-undeclared
invalid._why: a name neither shared nor the Satellite's own

invalid.name: own-icon-raw-svg
invalid._why: a client draws only absolute M, L, C and Z: never markup or other commands

invalid.name: audio-menu-section-action
invalid.error: the player runs navigate, play, choose or a route action

invalid.name: audio-menu-download
invalid.error: the player runs navigate, play, choose or a route action

invalid.name: follows-not-a-list
invalid.error: must be a list of capabilities
